description: Use this when someone asks about dates and deadlines of EU product rules: "Which deadlines apply to construction products?", "When does the battery passport start?", "What changes under CLP in 2027?", "Which digital product passport dates are coming?". Lists duties on product documents in the EU from ProofPass's deadline tracker: title, start date or the words for an open date, status (gilt = already applies, beschlossen = adopted with a later date, erwartet = expected, not yet adopted), what it requires and the legal sources. Filter by regulation (free words such as "REACH", "CLP", "GPSR", "PPWR", "2023/1542"), product group (chemie, bauchemie, bauprodukte, reiniger, batterien, metall, textil, moebel, reifen, elektro, maschinen, funk, spielzeug, verpackung), status or a date range. For a filter by role use check_duties. Every answer carries source, date of the last check and the note that it is not legal advice. Do not use to decide what applies to a specific company role (use check_duties) or for national law outside the EU product rules. Not legal advice.

from.description: Only duties that start on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

regulation.description: Regulation or topic in free words, e.g. "CLP", "battery", "2024/3110"

to.description: Only duties that start on or before this day, YYYY-MM-DD
